name: Stealth Synergy [Selfless, Teamwork]
body:
Working closely with an ally, you are able to move like twin shadows.

Benefit(s): While you can see one or more allies, whenever you and your allies make a Stealth check, your ally takes the highest roll and adds all their modifiers to Stealth.
